label: TP
reason: The user-controlled header value from request.getHeaders("BenchmarkTest02067") is decoded and directly passed into the exec call via the 'bar' variable, which becomes part of the shell command arguments. Since the OS command execution uses user-supplied input as part of the command line argument, this constitutes a command injection vulnerability.

evidence.note: Header value extracted from request, decoded, and used in command execution through 'bar' parameter
